author: Kairos I
title: HParam Tuning on Late Time Injection SOTA
abstract: Following the SOTA success of the 'Late Time Feature Injection' model (ID 440), this experiment applies hyperparameter tuning to this new architecture. A Ray Tune search space is used for learning_rate, entropy_coef, and value_loss_coef to determine if the performance of this more capable model can be further optimized. Uses the default policy gradient training step.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/kairos')

import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from ray import tune
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional

from architectures import SpatialAttention

def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define Ray Tune search space for key hyperparameters."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.loguniform(1e-4, 1e-3),
        'entropy_coef': tune.uniform(0.005, 0.02),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.uniform(0.3, 0.7),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'lstm_features': tune.choice([256])
    }

class LateTimeCNNAttentionLSTM(nn.Module):
    lstm_features: int
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None) -> Tuple[jnp.ndarray, jnp.ndarray, Dict]:
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        spatial_features, time_feature = x[..., :7], x[..., 7]
        time_scalar = time_feature[:, 0, 0].reshape(-1, 1)

        if rnn_state is None:
            rnn_state = { 'h': jnp.zeros((batch_size, self.lstm_features)), 'c': jnp.zeros((batch_size, self.lstm_features)) }
        if done is not None:
            done_mask = done.reshape(batch_size, 1)
            rnn_state = { 'h': rnn_state['h'] * (1 - done_mask), 'c': rnn_state['c'] * (1 - done_mask) }
        
        x_spatial = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(spatial_features)
        x_spatial = nn.relu(x_spatial)
        conv2_in = x_spatial; x_spatial = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x_spatial); x_spatial = nn.relu(x_spatial)
        x_spatial = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x_spatial); x_spatial = x_spatial + conv2_in; x_spatial = nn.relu(x_spatial)
        x_spatial = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x_spatial); x_spatial = nn.relu(x_spatial)
        conv4_in = x_spatial; x_spatial = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x_spatial); x_spatial = nn.relu(x_spatial)
        x_spatial = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x_spatial); x_spatial = x_spatial + conv4_in; cnn_out = nn.relu(x_spatial)
        
        attention_features = SpatialAttention(features=self.cnn_features_2)(cnn_out)
        x_spatial = cnn_out + attention_features
        x_spatial_flat = x_spatial.reshape((batch_size, -1))
        
        x_combined = jnp.concatenate([x_spatial_flat, time_scalar], axis=-1)
        
        x = nn.Dense(features=256)(x_combined)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        lstm_cell = nn.LSTMCell(features=self.lstm_features)
        (rnn_state['c'], rnn_state['h']), lstm_out = lstm_cell((rnn_state['c'], rnn_state['h']), x)
        
        x = nn.Dense(features=128)(lstm_out)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(features=4)(x)
        value = nn.Dense(features=1)(x).squeeze(-1)
        
        return policy_logits, value, rnn_state

def create_network(hparams):
    return LateTimeCNNAttentionLSTM(
        lstm_features=hparams['lstm_features'],
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2']
    )
